newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish car production falls three pct in July.
newsitem.headline: Turkish car production falls three pct in July.

text.p: Turkish passenger car production fell three percent year-on-year in July to 21,523 units, the Automotive Industry Association (OSD) said on Monday.
Car production in the first seven months of 1997 rose slightly to 132,770 units from 132,727 a year earlier, the OSD said in its monthly bulletin.
Compared to a year ago, Turkey's overall motor vehicle output was up eight percent to 32,345 in July and nine percent to 212,823 in the first seven months of this year.
Last month, commercial vehicle output was up 39 percent to 6,545 units and tractor production grew by 34 percent to 4,277, compared to July 1996, the OSD said.
On a seven-month basis, commercial vehicle production jumped 49 percent to 50,118 compared to the same 1996 period and tractor output was two percent firmer at 29,935.

Commercial vehicle output in the first seven months was led by trucks, up 55 percent to 21,859 and pick ups, up 46 percent to 15,274. Production of midi-buses leapt 83 percent, mini-buses 24 percent and buses 30 percent in the seven-month period.
